scope: 311 requests filed 2025-01-01 to 2026-10-12, one row per REQUESTID; closure class from scripts/night/N2/classes.py

columns.label: Promise date
columns.help: The city sets a promised completion date (PRJCOMPLETEDATE) on the request.

columns.label: Closing words say done
columns.help: Share of closures whose words record finished work: mostly (50% or more), sometimes (15–49%), rarely (under 15%).

columns.label: Independent record of the work
columns.help: A city record of the work itself, outside the 311 request.

columns.label: Joined here
columns.help: This prototype joins the request to that record.

columns.label: Work orders attached (public status page)
columns.help: Whether the City's public status page lists inspections or work orders attached to the request (E1's sample of status pages).
